How it's scored

Half Weekly Catch, half everywhere else

Weights

Only the show itself counts: the 11 PM to midnight playlist hour that follows it on Spinitron isn't hosted, so its spins are left out. A signal a song has no data for counts as the median (0.5), so outside data can move a song at most ±25 points from its airplay-driven score. Airplay is capped at 50% of the score.

Signals

  • Airplay: each Weekly Catch spin from 9 to 11 PM, weighted by the episode's Mixcloud plays, fading with a 14-day half-life.
  • Radio: how many other stations played the song in the last 28 days (plus a little per play), from stations' automatic now-playing posts on Bluesky.
  • Streaming: Deezer rank, plus ListenBrainz and Last.fm listener counts.
  • Scrobbles: Last.fm and ListenBrainz plays gained over 7 days.
  • Video: YouTube views gained over 7 days.
  • Momentum: streaming level versus 7 days earlier.

Scrobbles, video, and momentum need a week of daily snapshots, so they fill in from about Nov 21.

pct[song, signal, day] = percentile among eligible songs that day (0–1) points[song, day] = 100 × Σ weight × (pct, or 0.5 if no data) → 0–100 daily = points that day · weekly = Σ Fri → Thu · month/year to date = Σ since the 1st eligible for 26 weeks after a song's first Weekly Catch spin · ties: more spins, then latest spin
